episodes.title: Part 1: The Inciting Spark
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley and her family settle into Angamaly; her first choir session with Justin sparks an instant musical connection.
episodes.recap_text: Following financial distress in Mundakkayam, Ashley relocates to Angamaly and joins the parish prayer unit.
episodes.teaser_next: Secret late-night choir rehearsals begin to raise suspicions among watchful elders.

episodes.title: Part 2: Rhythms & Rumors
episodes.break_rationale: Justin and Ashley bond over music across Angamaly; romantic sparks fly during late-night scooter rides.
episodes.recap_text: Banter and music rehearsals blossom into a secret romance despite watchful neighbors.
episodes.teaser_next: The grand parish feast arrives as family tensions escalate.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Parish Feast
episodes.break_rationale: Justin confesses his genuine feelings before the feast performance just as neighborhood rumors peak.
episodes.recap_text: Their triumphant choir performance captivates the church, but family scrutiny reaches a boiling point.
episodes.teaser_next: An unexpected letter from Dublin arrives, threatening to alter Ashley's future.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Ireland Dilemma
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley receives her student visa for Ireland; emotional midnight farewell at the airport gate.
episodes.recap_text: Torn between her Dublin dreams and Justin, Ashley leaves as Justin selflessly lets her go.
episodes.teaser_next: Eighteen months pass in Ireland before a parish wedding brings Ashley back to Kerala.

episodes.title: Part 5: Return to Angamaly
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley returns to Kerala for the wedding, discovering Justin waiting across the church courtyard.
episodes.recap_text: Returning after 18 months in Dublin, Ashley confronts unspoken feelings and past memories.
episodes.teaser_next: The wedding ceremony begins as Ashley and Justin take center stage.

episodes.title: Part 6: Harmonies of Bethlehem
episodes.break_rationale: Joyful choir wedding finale brings Ashley and Justin's romance to a triumphant conclusion.
episodes.recap_text: Ashley and Justin reunite in a joyful musical celebration at the parish hall.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the 6-episode miniseries cut of Bethlehem Kudumba Unit!
